title: Simulation prefix encoding
statement: For a finite binary Turing machine $M$, a natural number $n$, and a bit string $z$, define the prefix bit string by concatenating $n$ copies of $1$, then $0$, then the gate encoding of the two constant gates for false and true, followed by the gate encodings of one constant gate for each bit of $z$, and finally the gate encodings of $W_d(M)$ constant-false gates.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite binary Turing machine
